description:
Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) was launched on May 9 2015. 

It aims to provide life insurance coverage to individuals in the age group of 18 to 50 years. 

The objective is to offer financial security to families in case of the policyholder's untimely death. 

The scheme provides a life cover of Rs. 2 lakh at a premium of Rs. 330 per annum. 

The benefits include a lump sum payment to the nominee in the event of the policyholder's death due to any reason. 

Eligibility criteria include being an Indian citizen aged between 18 and 50 years. 

The applicant must have a savings bank account. 

Enrollment can be done through banks and financial institutions. 

The application process involves filling out a form and providing necessary identification documents. 

The premium is automatically debited from the bank account on an annual basis. 

The scheme is implemented by the Life Insurance Corporation of India and other private insurance companies. 

The coverage is provided for one year and can be renewed annually. 

The scheme is available to all eligible individuals across India.
